response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C and C++ (National Instruments), but his recent work has been heavily focused on web, mobile, and scripting languages (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Dlang, JavaScript). His lack of recent C++ STL or high-performance systems experience, along with no direct exposure to industrial automation or IoT protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.), raises concerns about his current fit for this role. Additionally, he lacks experience with secure development lifecycles (SDL) and IEC 62443 standards.
strengths: Strong background in C/C++ from early career (National Instruments)
Experience with high-performance systems (low-latency apps with Dlang)
Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt across diverse technologies
concerns: Limited recent C++ STL or high-performance systems experience
No documented experience with industrial automation protocols or IoT systems
Lacks exposure to secure development lifecycles (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards
